name: Cleanliness (Taharah)

definition_by_age.4: Keeping your hands and things clean.
definition_by_age.6: Taharah means keeping your body, clothes, and space clean as part of faith.
definition_by_age.8: Taharah is physical and spiritual cleanliness, an important part of preparing for prayer and daily life.

learning_objective: Children can describe washing hands before eating and why.

recommended_default.note: Reassigned 2026-08-05 during pattern-diversity fix (was pattern_002). Question->Discovery->Practice->Reward fits learning WHY cleanliness matters through discovery, better than generic mistake-reflection.

alternative_patterns.reasoning: Frustration during wudu resolving through natural experience, not adult correction.
Not cleaning up is a genuine mistake-reflection-correction shape.
